subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and failover scenarios for SIG review
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@tidegate.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tidegate.com
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and failover scenarios for SIG review

Hi Avery,

As part of Tidegate's SIG and CAIQ review, we need a concise package showing Redwood's recovery commitments and empirical evidence for RTO/RPO across a few representative failure modes. Specifically, could you provide: 

- Measured RTO/RPO samples for: single-AZ failover, full-region failure with cross-region failover, and cold restore from backups.
- A short runbook extract showing steps and estimated operator time for a manual restore (for audit).
- Timestamped log excerpts (redaction ok) that show a full restore sequence and KV cache rehydration.
- Ownership and on-call manifest (who is responsible during a live witness).
- Any SIG/CAIQ control mappings (pointer to SOC 2 artifacts) relevant to continuity.

We'd need these items by end of business Oct 15 to keep our compliance review on schedule. If you can also offer a 30–45 minute live witness/demo (playback of a restore) on Oct 14 afternoon, that would be ideal.

We will treat documents containing operational detail under NDA (we have an NDA in place). Let me know what you can share and any constraints.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Head of Security
Tidegate Capital
maya.singh@tidegate.com
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and failover scenarios for SIG review

Folks — forwarding Tidegate's ask (below). Timeline is tight (need by COB 10/15). Proposed split of work: 

- Marissa: assemble the runbook excerpts, escalation manifest, and a 1-page procedural summary for the auditor. Include contact names/roles and any recent tabletop dates.
- Ben: prepare the SIG control mapping and a short statement on SOC 2 Type II availability controls. Also draft the attestation language we can sign.
- Priyom: pull the empirical timelines. We need measured RTOs for single-AZ failover, cross-region warm-failover, and cold restore. Include raw log excerpts (redact PII). If you can produce a short CSV of measured runs that would be perfect.

I will coordinate the packaging and upload to a secure Drive. Ben, can you confirm legal/attestation language with compliance? Marissa, can you own the live witness scheduling? Priyom — please prioritize the cross-region warm failover timings; Tidegate will care about RTO tail latencies.

Thanks — Avery
Avery Johnson
Principal, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 13:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and failover scenarios for SIG review

Quick update on the empirical side — I ran 12 controlled restore/replay jobs yesterday on the prod-like cluster we use for continuity exercises. High-level observations below (CSV attached):

- single-AZ failover (auto-evac + node reschedule): median RTO 00:02:45, 95th 00:04:20
- cross-region warm failover (KV cache saved + streaming replication): median RTO 00:03:30, 95th 00:06:10
- cold restore from backup (cold JVM / cache rebuild): median RTO 00:18:40, 95th 00:27:15

KV cache rehydration patterns: small keysets (<=100k keys) typically warm in <3m; large keysets (multi-million) took 12–25m depending on parallelism. Attached kv-snapshots-20271011.tar.gz contains sample manifests and checksums.

Artifacts attached: rto-rpo-observations.csv, kv-snapshots-20271011.tar.gz. I will redact any internal IPs and keep only timestamps and op-types. Planning to capture a short filtered log (restore_timeline.csv) showing a typical warm failover sequence for the Drive packet.

One ask: for the auditor pack, we should provide both a high-level measured table and one full trace (redacted) showing end-to-end timings. Confirming I'll hand the trace to Marissa to include.

— Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@tidegate.com>, Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 11:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: RTO/RPO evidence and failover scenarios for SIG review

Hi Maya — thanks for the request and patience. We compiled a short evidence packet and uploaded it to a secure folder (link below). Packet includes: 

- redwood-bcp-summary.pdf (2-page executive summary with measured RTO/RPO table and ownership)
- restore_timeline.csv (redacted timestamp sequence for a warm failover)
- rto-rpo-observations.csv (aggregate measurements from 12 runs)
- kv-snapshots-20271011.tar.gz (sample manifests, checksums)
- SOC2-type2-availability-pointer.txt (how to request the full SOC 2 under NDA)

Drive folder (restricted link, view-only to tidegate security): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_secure_link

Per SIG/CAIQ — we've mapped the relevant continuity controls to our SOC 2 availability controls; a short mapping table is included in redwood-bcp-summary.pdf. If you need the full CAIQ matrix filled out, we can populate the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet but that usually requires additional time to attach evidentiary references — happy to do so if you confirm scope.

We also scheduled a 30-minute live witness run on Oct 14 at 14:00 PDT to replay a warm failover and walk through the runbook. Join link and dial-in will be shared by Calendar invite. If that time doesn't work, propose alternatives and we'll adjust.

Attestation: Redwood is able to provide a signed statement of the measured runs above (sample attestation language attached). For Tidegate procurement, I've cc'd the packet and included SOC2 access instructions.

If Tidegate wants a condensed 4–5 slide summary for exec reviewers ahead of the live witness, tell us the target audience and we'll prepare it before the call.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Security & Compliance Lead | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
